title: New worktrees go to a repo-local folder, not the project's sibling worktrees folder
body: What happened: after the 0.9.0 upgrade, warden start --worktree made the worktree inside the repo at .worktrees/PG-340 and also .worktrees/PG-340-fix-1. The project docs and the still-live older run use the sibling folder warden-playground.worktrees/. The upgrade notes did not mention this change. Expected: the same folder as the existing worktrees, or a note in the upgrade text. Steps: upgrade 0.8.1 to 0.9.0, then warden start <id> --template feature --worktree. Evidence: git worktree list showed warden-playground.worktrees/PG-333 for the old run, and start printed worktree .../warden-playground/.worktrees/PG-340 for the new one.
